questions.question: Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan asosiy buyruqlar: navigatsiya va fayl amallari.
Matn bilan ishlash: `grep`, `cut`, `sort`, `uniq`, `wc`, `tr` — har biri nima uchun?
questions.explanation: grep — qator filtrlash; cut — ustun kesish; sort — saralash; uniq — ketma-ket takrorlarni olib tashlash/sanash (avval sort); wc — sanash; tr — belgi almashtirish.

questions.question: `sed` va `awk` qachon ishlatiladi? Tipik misollar.
questions.explanation: sed — oqim tahrirlovchi: almashtirish, qator o'chirish, in-place. awk — ustunli matn: maydon bo'yicha filtr, hisob-kitob, agregatsiya.

questions.question: `jq` nima va DevOps'da qanday ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: JSON uchun sed/awk: filtr, maydon olish, transformatsiya. kubectl/aws/API javoblarini skriptda parse qilish uchun.

questions.question: `tee`, `sort -u`, `diff`, `comm`, `watch`, `timeout` — qachon foydali?
questions.explanation: tee — chiqishni ham ekranga, ham faylga; diff/comm — fayllarni solishtirish; watch — buyruqni davriy; timeout — osilib qolmaslik uchun vaqt chegarasi.

questions.question: vim'da asosiy ishlar: ochish, tahrirlash, saqlash, chiqish, qidirish.
questions.explanation: Rejimlar: Normal (Esc), Insert (`i`), Command (`:`). `:w` saqlash, `:q!` saqlamay chiqish, `:wq`/`ZZ`, `/text` qidirish, `dd` qator o'chirish, `u` undo.

questions.question: nano va vim farqi; serverda qaysi biri?
questions.explanation: nano — oddiy, pastda yorliqlar (`Ctrl+O` saqlash, `Ctrl+X` chiqish), yangi boshlovchi uchun. vim — modal, tez, kuchli, deyarli har serverda `vi` bor.

questions.question: Config faylni serverda xavfsiz tahrirlash qoidalari?
questions.explanation: Avval backup, maxsus vositalar (`visudo`, `crontab -e`, `systemctl edit`), sintaksis tekshiruv (`nginx -t`, `sshd -t`), reload; aslida — qo'lda emas, config management (Ansible/Git).

questions.question: vim'da bir nechta qator / blok bilan ishlash: visual mode, `:g`, makro.
questions.explanation: `V` — qator tanlash, `Ctrl+v` — ustun bloki (ko'p qatorga birdaniga yozish), `:g/pat/d` — mos qatorlarni o'chirish, `q` — makro yozish.

questions.question: `chmod`, `chown`, `chgrp` flaglari va misollar (`-R`, symbolic va octal).
questions.explanation: chmod u/g/o/a +-= r/w/x yoki octal (755). chown user:group. -R rekursiv. Katalog uchun x = kirish huquqi.

questions.question: `grep` eng kerakli flaglari?
questions.explanation: -i katta-kichik farqsiz, -r rekursiv, -n qator raqami, -v teskari, -c soni, -l faqat fayl nomi, -w butun so'z, -E regex, -F fixed string, -o faqat moslik, -A/-B/-C kontekst.

questions.question: `tail -f`, `less`, `head`, `wc` — log ko'rishning amaliy usullari?
questions.explanation: `tail -f`/`-F` real vaqt (F — rotate'dan keyin ham), `tail -n 200`, `less +F` (kuzatish + qidiruv), `head -n`, `wc -l` qatorlar soni.

questions.question: logrotate qanday ishlaydi? `copytruncate` va `create` farqi?
questions.explanation: cron/timer bilan kuniga bir marta `/etc/logrotate.d/*` bo'yicha loglarni aylantiradi, siqadi, eskisini o'chiradi. create — faylni rename qilib yangisini yaratadi (ilovaga signal kerak); copytruncate — nusxa olib asl faylni 0 ga qisqartiradi (signal kerak emas, lekin qator yo'qolishi mumkin).

questions.question: Disk joyini tez topish: `df`, `du`, `ncdu` flaglari.
questions.explanation: `df -hT` FS bo'yicha, `df -i` inode, `du -sh *`, `du -xh --max-depth=1 / | sort -h`, `ncdu -x /`. -x — boshqa FS'ga o'tmaslik.

questions.question: `awk` / `sed` / `sort` / `uniq` bilan access log tahlili (top IP, top URL, 5xx).
questions.explanation: Pipeline: maydonni ajrat (awk '{print $1}') -> sort -> uniq -c -> sort -rn -> head. sed — almashtirish/qator tanlash.

questions.question: Fayl va katalog nusxalash/ko'chirish: `cp -a`, `mv`, `rm -rf` xavflari, `ln -s`, `mkdir -p`, `install`.
questions.explanation: cp -a — ruxsat, egasi, vaqt, symlink saqlanadi. rm -rf — qaytarib bo'lmaydi; o'zgaruvchi bo'sh bo'lsa `rm -rf $DIR/` = `rm -rf /`. mkdir -p — ota kataloglar bilan.
